device.title: EnOcean gateway
device.description: Serial device path (e.g. /dev/serial/by-id/usb-EnOcean_GmbH_USB_300_...) or a TCP socket URL (e.g. tcp://enocean-host:3334, such as a ser2net raw accepter).

baud.title: Serial baud rate
baud.description: Serial baud rate (EnOcean USB300 uses 57600). Ignored for tcp:// gateways.

teachIn.title: Teach-in logging
teachIn.description: Log unknown EnOcean sender ids and their raw telegrams to help discover device ids. Enable temporarily while adding devices.

devices.title: Devices
devices.description: The EnOcean devices to expose as Matter bridged devices.

name.title: Name
name.description: Friendly name shown in Matter controllers.

eep.title: EEP
eep.description: EnOcean Equipment Profile, e.g. F6-02-01 (rocker) or F6-10-00 (window handle). Used to infer the profile. For rockers, F6-02-01 (Style 1, EU) and F6-02-02 (Style 2, US) are the same switch mounted the other way up: choosing the EEP flips the top/bottom button names and tags.

profile.title: Profile (optional)
profile.description: Explicit profile name overriding the one inferred from the EEP.

buttons.title: Buttons (rocker only)
buttons.description: Number of momentary buttons to expose for a rocker (default 4).

buttonNames.title: Button names (rocker only)
buttonNames.description: Optional friendly names per button, in index order, overriding the EEP-derived defaults (Rocker A Bottom, Rocker A Top, Rocker B Bottom, Rocker B Top). Leave empty to use the standard names. The semantic position tags are always applied.

unregisterOnShutdown.title: Unregister On Shutdown
unregisterOnShutdown.description: Unregister all devices on shutdown. Only for debugging purposes, not recommended for production use.

debug.title: Enable Debug
debug.description: Enable debug mode for the plugin.
